title: CNC turning of case profile
description: CNC turning of case profile capability for titanium components
thicknessRange: Up to 400 mm diameter x 1000 mm length
processDescription: CNC turning of titanium on multi-axis lathes produces cylindrical components with precision diameters and surface finishes. Live tooling enables milling and drilling in the same setup, specifically for watch case. Precision watch case for Watchmaking, Consumer present unique challenges: Cosmetic surface finish (mirror polish, brush, or bead blast) with sub-mm feature detail. Material traceability from mill to finished case.
heatControl: Minimal heat generation due to fine finishing passes. Air blast for chip clearing sufficient; coolant not required for cosmetic finishing passes.
flatnessControl: Steady rests for long slender parts. Stress-relieved stock recommended.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for CNC turning of case profile, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
